title: LSTM RUL — Severson 2019 + PyBaMM BBU-duty + ONNX edge inference
description: PyTorch 2-layer LSTM (hidden=64) trained on per-cycle summary features from 188 LFP cells (138 Severson 2019 batches 1+2+3 + 50 PyBaMM-calibrated BBU-duty cells to close the regime gap, see whitepaper §3.3.5). Exported to ONNX and benchmarked under onnxruntime CPU as a proxy for the STM32N6 NPU deployment path.
